title: Listening Drill — Food hall route
description: Directions dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Food hall route
sections.transcript:
VISITOR: I'm trying to get to the new food hall. My map shows two possible routes. Which one would you recommend?

ASSISTANT: Start at the west doors. From there, walk towards the service desk. Stay on the same side until you can see the sign for the food court.

VISITOR: Can I go through the middle? It looks a lot shorter on the map.

ASSISTANT: I'd avoid the main escalator today. It is out of service this morning. If you're meeting a group, wait by the sign so they can spot you.
